# Flow 9: calibrate and jump, first on an empty planet, then with a tool the Captain has trusted.
#
# Calibrate reconciles drift; jump moves the Captain into a planet after making it ready. With
# nothing attached both have nothing to do. With a real tool they ask the Captain once, and once the
# Captain has trusted the tool's commands, daily use runs without a prompt.

step set up: the vessel, a galaxy and an empty planet
exec orbiter --output json vessel init -y
exec orbiter galaxy add acme-corp
exec orbiter planet add payments-api --galaxy acme-corp

step with nothing attached, calibrate and jump have nothing to do
exec orbiter calibrate payments-api
stdout 'nothing to calibrate'
exec orbiter jump payments-api --yes

step attach git, and let the first calibrate ask the Captain and look for git
exec orbiter resource add git-tool --role tool --brand git
exec orbiter attach git-tool payments-api
client -- calibrate payments-api
stdout '"status":"needs_discovery"'
capture SESSION '"session":"([0-9a-z]+)"'
capture TXN '"txn":"([0-9a-z]+)","op":"FIND_BINARY"'

step the shell of the Captain finds git, and the run continues
exec $FLOW_SHELL -c 'eval "$(orbiter shell init)"; FIND_BINARY "$TXN" git'
client -- uplink --session=$SESSION
stdout '"action":"healthy"'

step the shell the profile line registered is on the vessel too, so it has to be located once as well
client -- calibrate payments-api
stdout '"status":"needs_discovery"'
stdout '"op":"FIND_BINARY","key":"'$FLOW_SHELL'"'
capture SESSION '"session":"([0-9a-z]+)"'
capture TXN '"txn":"([0-9a-z]+)","op":"FIND_BINARY"'
exec $FLOW_SHELL -c 'eval "$(orbiter shell init)"; FIND_BINARY "$TXN" '$FLOW_SHELL
client -- uplink --session=$SESSION
stdout '"action":"healthy"'

step everything is trusted and located, so calibrate and jump run quietly
exec orbiter calibrate payments-api
stdout 'tool/git'
exec orbiter jump payments-api --yes

step jumping to something that does not exist is a mistake
! exec orbiter jump nonexistent-planet --yes
stderr 'not found|no target'
